note: WIST-4 §3, §4 roster derivation: per case a Log prefix of roster acts in Log order, the indices a replayer rejects (WIST4-E07), and the key an auditor_id holds at queried instants; a removal retires the key_id and the public_key admitted under it, and an admit naming either a retired one or one another admission holds is rejected. public_key is an abstract label for the key octets. An auditor_remove carries `evidence` exactly as the Registry Update does: present and naming at least one ID when the removal is for cause, absent for an exit or a rotation. Batch cases start after removals with signatures and the non-roster details contracts already validated; their inputs exercise key and subject conflicts, not admission merits.
